item.title: Google Chrome update will close the door on ad blockers
item.description:
📝 CyberNews points out a Chromium commit that removes support for the “kExtensionManifestV2Disabled” flag, which is referred to as “dead code” seeing as Chrome no longer supports Manifest V2 extensions. This will also impact other Chromium-based browsers, though the comment notes that “other browsers can continue supporting these if they so desire. Chrome 151 (expected July 2026): Will remove the remaining flags (ExtensionManifestV2Unsupported, ExtensionManifestV2Availability, and AllowLegacyMV2Extensions).
🔗 Read more: https://9to5google.com/2026/06/15/google-chromes-next-update-will-mark-the-end-of-popular-ad-blockers/
